def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def split_blocks(grid, sep):
    """Split the grid on rows and columns that are one color (sep) throughout; return the 2D list of subgrids."""
    zr = [i for i, r in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in r)]
    zc = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(r[j] == sep for r in grid)]
    rr = [-1] + zr + [len(grid)]; cc = [-1] + zc + [len(grid[0])]
    return [[[row[c0+1:c1] for row in grid[r0+1:r1]]
             for c0, c1 in zip(cc, cc[1:])] for r0, r1 in zip(rr, rr[1:])]

def detect_sep(grid):
    """The color that forms at least one full row (the grid's separator color), or None."""
    for row in grid:
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            c = row[0]
            if any(all(r[j] == c for r in grid) for j in range(len(grid[0]))):
                return c
    return None

def block_marker_map(grid, sep=-1):
    """One cell per block: 1 if the block holds an even count of its non-separator minority color, else that block's background color."""
    if sep == -1:
        sep = detect_sep(grid)
    out = []
    for row in split_blocks(grid, sep):
        cells = []
        for blk in row:
            vals = [v for r in blk for v in r]
            marker = min((v for v in set(vals) if v != sep), key=vals.count)
            n = vals.count(marker)
            bg = max((v for v in set(vals) if v != sep), key=vals.count)
            cells.append(1 if n % 2 == 0 else bg)
        out.append(cells)
    return out
